Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1164

Tracking

  • Gang: tracks on one rigid thing share one motion while tracking. A track whose feature is hidden is carried by the others and picks its own feature up again when it's back. The tracks list marks each gang.
  • Average now gives the same track as the reference compositor: keyed wherever any selected track has a key.
  • A track no longer takes featureless picture for a match.

Roto and paint

  • A clone or reveal can take its source from another frame: relative to the current one, or a set frame.
  • The Layers panel's motion blur, blending, lock and lifetime columns work.

Animation

  • The Motion window's Time and Character groups: hold, step, loop, ping-pong, stutter or speed ramp a knob's own animation; give its moves an overshoot, an anticipation, a settle, a bounce in or a wobble.
  • The Curve Editor's list can show the knobs without keys too, faint: one click keys a knob at the current frame.

Nagi

  • Auto Setup and Lock work: Auto Setup measures the clip and sets the controls with the preset on top; Lock holds the noise measured around the current frame.
  • Move the box to flat picture: one click when the profile box sits on detail.

Elsewhere

  • A flipbook can be made as the Viewer shows it: worked out at its downscale, played at full size.

Not yet

  • X-spline shapes; Follow a track in the Roto point menu.

Kento Alpha 0.6, build 1129

Roto and paint

  • The Roto panel in tabs (Roto, Transform, Lifetime, Tracking): several shapes picked take a change together; a typed value sets them all, a drag moves each by the same amount.
  • The point menu in full: Convert to Bezier, B-spline or Polygon, Feather falloff, Track this point (T), Bake track into keys, Open shape here, Broken tangents (B) and Lock point (L).
  • Open splines: drawn and outlined as a line with round ends, and a tool to draw them (click the points, Enter ends it).
  • Track the shape forward, from the Tracking tab: the picked shape follows the picture, its translate keyed.
  • Every paint tool works: Blur, Sharpen, Smear, Dodge and Burn join Brush, Eraser, Clone and Reveal (X and D keys). Blur and Sharpen take their size from the brush menu's effect.
  • Strokes blend with their blending mode (the stroke inspector has the menu), premultiply matches, and a pen's pressure can drive the brush's size as well as its opacity.
  • A picked stroke's points can be moved and deleted in the Viewer. With falloff on in the tool row, a drag carries the neighbouring points too, to nothing at the reach.
  • Animated shapes now land where they should between keys.

Warps

  • SplineWarp built in the Viewer: pins first, Bezier and B-spline shapes, boundaries, joins, a link to a Tracker and freezing at a frame.
  • GridWarp in the Viewer: the grids, their points and tangents, Fit, Copy and keys, and a link to a Tracker.

Color

  • What color space is this? is a contact sheet: the frame through each space it could be, most likely first. A space the file's name spells says so. Every space in the config is under a fold.
  • A Read's tile and the Viewer show its color space as a small tag; a click on the tag opens the menu. Studio rules can set a Read's color space by folder or name.
  • Utility > Match grade to colour checker: drag four corners onto a chart in the plate, any way up, and Kento fits a Grade or a colour matrix to it.

Tracking

  • The Tracker's reference can be fixed or updated every frame.
  • Average: a new track at the selected tracks' mean.

Footage and paths

  • Path maps as one table, a row per place with Mac, Windows and Linux columns; a studio map file is read first. A comp can carry its own maps, and a path fixed by hand can teach one.
  • Make paths relative to the comp's folder, from Relink or the File menu. Relink can match a sequence by its frame range as well as its name.
  • The footage browser scrubs a movie in its preview and gives a Photoshop file's layer count.

Nagi

  • Nagi's panel and tool row, the profile box in the Viewer with its measured noise (and a warning when it sits on detail), and the noise scopes.

Elsewhere

  • Utility > Show expressions lists every expression in the comp, as written.
  • Re-bake as you shape: a baked motion keeps its recipe, to shape and bake again.
  • The memory watcher warns once, with its fix one click away. The disk cache can clear itself when Kento quits and warns when its disk is nearly full.
  • A Bento has a Node tab to switch it off.
  • The Dope Sheet's Snap can snap to other keys and to marks.

Not yet

  • The Tracker's Gang; Nagi's Lock and Auto Setup; X-spline shapes.

Kento Alpha 0.6, build 1006

In this build

  • The menus keep working: in 1000 they stopped answering clicks after a while (their keys still worked).
  • An imported comp no longer lights up red: an error shows on the node it starts in, as a Read that can't find its file, not on everything downstream.
  • A Windows comp's Z:/kura and X:/kura footage reads on the Mac and Linux by default, through the studio's own path map.
  • Routed wires: a wire with no clear way round the nodes is drawn with square corners, never diagonal, and wires no longer twitch as the graph changes.
  • The Node Graph's Notes button shows or hides the sticky notes.
  • A node's menu: Select > Upstream, Downstream and All connected.

Not yet

  • Cameras and geometry still translate their paths one way, as a comp opens.
  • The path maps as a table with Mac, Windows and Linux columns; the noise scopes; re-bake as you shape.
